mapper.select: SELECT * FROM payment_transaction WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM payment_transaction WHERE intent_id = #{intentId} AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_transaction SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', provider_amount = #{providerAmount}, paid_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, failure_code = NULL, failure_message = NULL, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{operator} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND deleted = FALSE

UPDATE payment_transaction SET status = 'FAILED', failure_code = #{failureCode}, failure_message = #{failureMessage}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{operator} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND deleted = FALSE
